# TopBar

The top bar.

`LL.TopBar` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.TopBar title={…}>…</LL.TopBar>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.TopBar" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Props (TopBarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` | Character name or screen title. |
| `eyebrow` | `React.ReactNode` | Short context after the title: "Lv. 42", a region, a section. |
| `onMenu` | `() => void` | Shows the menu button (narrow screens only). |
| `center` | `React.ReactNode` | A Meter or Track centred in the bar. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Right-aligned: CurrencyPills, a Button. |
